output.summary: An evergreen hybrid shrub of garden origin, derived from Holantarctic Veronica elliptica and New Zealand Veronica speciosa. It has glossy dark-green leaves and dense clusters of blue-violet flowers with white throats. It tolerates salt spray and wind but is vulnerable to hard frost, especially inland.
